review_focus: Cross-user leak: any path by which one user's memory pointer (ID, category, consent) reaches another user's Graphify view, Turn State capability_index_hint, or any API surface that lists Graphify records.
Freshness: a user's own memories added, updated, confirmed or deleted after the context was built must be reflected; no memory content ever enters a record.
The shared _graphify_index (persisted, catalogue_ready) must be unchanged; the per-user capability/service refresh (graphify_refresh in server.py) must still work on the new view type.
No-login legacy path: the view must follow the current _memory_store; check startup order with _UserScopedStoreInitializer.
tests/graphify/conftest.py: placeholders must never replace installed packages or leak into other tests in the same run.
Cost and failure behaviour of re-reading the memory store on each lookup; never raises.
